Architecture BSc/BArch at University College London

What University College London asks of applicants to Architecture BSc/BArch for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

Entry requirements 2027 entry 0 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma (UCL’s AAB band, this course’s offer): 5,4 in two APs plus SAT 1440 or ACT 32, taken in the final three years of high school, with the High School Graduation Diploma
  • Alternatively 5,5,5 in three APs (taken in the final three years of high school), with no SAT/ACT

Chain: the 2027-entry course page (offer AAB) loads UCL’s international equivalency for its A-level band through its country selector; that data’s United States entry is shown here. Not re-checked automatically. Confirm this on the university’s page.

Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement: accepted — see note
  • Advanced Placement (UCL’s AAB band): 5,5,5 in three APs, or 5,4 in two APs plus SAT 1440 or ACT 32 with the High School Graduation Diploma
  • Subject requirements carry over:
    • an A* or A subject needs a 5 in the relevant full-year AP (a B needs a 4)
    • where Mathematics or Physics is required, specific AP subjects are asked for
  • AP scores must be verified and sent to UCL by the College Board

UCL’s 2027 international equivalency for the AAB band, which the course page’s country selector loads for this course. UCL also says one year at a recognised US university or college (CGPA 3.3/4.0, around 30 semester credits) may be considered. Not re-checked automatically. Confirm this on the university’s page.

Other requirements
  • Comprehensive portfolio of creative work: UCL requests a digital portfolio once you meet (or are likely to meet) the entry requirements — do not send it unless asked
  • You may then be invited to an online interview (Zoom)

Not re-checked automatically. Confirm this on the university’s page.
